name: Jahanara Begum
original_name: ジャハーナーラ・ベーグム
source:
Born in Pakistan, she moves to Japan together with her mother to improve their lives. She is caught up in the Koushin Disaster but survives and stays together with a group of survivors when Nao and Sachi show up. When the survivors are all killed by the monsters, she declares Nao as the "model" she strives to emulate and stays by his side even after leaving the Disaster Zone.

[Spoiler] After being adopted by a Japanese man when her mother marries to gain citizenship, she is subjected to constant sexual abuse by the paedophile foster father. When she experiences her first period, she is prostituted out as a source of income for her foster father. She endures it all in the hope she can make her mother happy in their new homeland but begins to despair she will never obtain happiness herself.

The extreme conditions she labours under are the trigger for the discovery of her telepathic powers. She then picks up the signals sent out by the intergalactic Gestalt and accepts their proposal. This fuses her consciousness with that of a representative from the Gestalt, granting her immortality and the power to transform organic and inorganic matter to facilitate the "conversion" process.

She glimpses Nao and Sachi cycling by her home every day when she looks outside and sees the pair as the very emblem of happiness she strives for. This is the main reason why she resurrects Nao and grants him his powers in hopes that the happiness of the pair is shared by the rest of the world. His declaration about the nature of humanity is taken as it is by Nara and the Gestalt which sets the bar for humanity's homogenisation too high for the vast majority of humans to clear.

She uses the experiences and outcomes of Nao's actions in the first two routes as data for the final timestream which determines the outcome of the homogenisation process. If he succeeds in postponing the process by deliberately introducing a paradox error in the Gestalt's data comparison process, she leaves earth to join the Gestalt and swears to defend it if the Gestalt returns once again to subject Earth to another homogenisation process. [/Spoiler]
